name: dispatch-time-plot-ready-active-promotion
description: warren-dfff / pl-e381 step 2: dispatch-time ready->active Plot promotion lives in src/plan-runs/plot-appender.ts as PlanRunPlotActivator + defaultPlanRunPlotActivator (open UserPlotClient, read(), if status==='ready' setStatus('active') else skip) + promotePlotToActiveOnDispatch fire-and-log wrapper logging plan_run.plot_activated (info) / plan_run.plot_activation_skipped (warn) / plan_run.plot_activation_failed (warn). Mirrors defaultPlotStatusSetter/autoTransitionPlotToDone in plot-transition.ts (the active->done auto-done side). Wired via optional planRunPlotActivator seam on ServerDeps, called right after emitPlanRunDispatchedToPlot inside the plotId guard in BOTH handlers/plan-runs.ts and handlers/plot-plan-runs.ts. Auto-done guard stays ===active; promotion just makes active reachable via dispatch as well as operator action. Note: a verbose ServerDeps doc-comment pushed src/server/types.ts past the 500-line check:size ceiling — keep new seam doc-comments terse.

content: isFatalHttpError (src/plan-runs/merge-gate.ts) is module-internal but consumed by TWO arms: checkParentRunMerged (parent gate, merge-gate.ts) and pollMergeState (child gate, in-flight.ts). Any change to the fatal-HTTP set needs regression tests in BOTH files — parent-gate cases in coordinator.gating.test.ts and child-gate cases in coordinator.completion.test.ts. Narrowed to 404/410 only (warren-eccd / pl-30ae): 401/403/429 are 'cannot verify right now' and fall through to keep-waiting in both arms, bounded by the merge-wait budget (warren-3937); only 404/410 (PR genuinely gone) fail with parent_pr_not_merged / pr_closed_without_merge.

description: reap.empty_push on a succeeded child with no prUrl was unconditionally scored as a trivial merge in resolveMissingPrUrl (src/plan-runs/in-flight.ts), conflating 'agent had nothing to commit' with 'agent could not find its seed and did no work'. In prod (plnr_4tn7zxf11crp), child warren-dbda whose seed never resolved in its workspace clone was recorded merged/trivial, masking warren-486c and making the plan die one seq later at the wrong child_seed_not_found.
resolution: warren-2a8c: gate the empty-push trivial merge on resolveChildSeed(input) via showSeed. Unresolved (SeedNotFoundError) -> failChild with typed reason child_seed_not_resolved:<seedId>; transient sd failure -> retryable noop seed_check_failed:<runId> (mirrors coordinator dispatch-arm semantics); only a resolved seed merges trivially. showSeed host-side resolution is the proxy for 'seed reachable from the ref child pods clone'.

name: plan-run-live-dogfood
description: First full live dogfood of the plan-run coordinator (plnr_sr3nx8ds688s, plan pl-116e, 6-step serial chain): POST /plan-runs with {project, planId, agent, promptTemplate ({seed_id} placeholder), providerOverride, modelOverride} walked all six children, gated each dispatch on the previous PR merging (auto-merge + gh CI), auto-closed each seed, and went terminal succeeded with zero coordinator faults. One repair run needed (CI test nondeterminism), dispatched onto the PR branch via targetBranch; total 7 runs, ~$5.20, PRs #799-#804. promptTemplate carrying 'sd show {seed_id}' + plan-show + gates-terminal instructions was sufficient — no per-step prompt customization required.

name: plan-run-child-retry
description: Automatic child retry (warren-6de9): retryable-cause list + budget predicates live in src/plan-runs/retry.ts; budget persists on plan_run_children.retry_count; retry events must be emitted on the NEW child run id because tail-events fans out over current child run ids; re-dispatch requires the running → dispatched child transition (legalized in CHILD_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS).
